name: Menu Go to – Quick Menu, Menu Navigator, Shortcut Navigation, No More Searching
author: Santosh Kori

sections.description:
Go to Menu – Quick Menu, Menu Navigator is a WordPress plugin that enhances site navigation efficiency by providing a “Quick Menu” access feature. With a simple press of the F2 key, users can open a search box to navigate through any registered menu. Say goodbye to manual scrolling—save time and increase productivity with the ultimate menu navigation tool.

Key Features:

  • Adds a settings page under “Go to Menu” in the WordPress admin area.
  • Includes options to enable or disable the plugin’s functionality for both frontend and backend areas.
  • When activated, the F2 keyboard shortcut opens a modal, allowing users to quickly select a menu from a dropdown list.
  • Fully accessible and keyboard-friendly, providing easy “Go to Menu” functionality with navigation using keyboard keys.
  • Perfect for users who want a “Quick Menu” solution or a “Menu Navigator” that simplifies site management.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the gotomenu folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “GoToMenu” settings page in the WordPress admin area.
  4. Toggle “Enable for Frontend” to activate the plugin’s functionality on the Frontend.
  5. Toggle “Enable for backend” to activate the plugin’s functionality on the Backend WP Admin Area.
sections.faq:
How do I activate the “Go to Menu” feature on my site?

After installing and activating the plugin, go to the “Go to Menu” settings page in the WordPress admin area and toggle the “Enable for Frontend” option.

Who can use the F2 key to access the “Quick Menu” modal?

All users, including guest users, can use the F2 key to open the “Go to Menu” modal and navigate menus if the “Enable for Frontend” option is activated.

Can I change the keyboard shortcut for the “Menu Navigator”?

Currently, the plugin only supports the F2 key as the shortcut to open the “Quick Menu” modal. Future updates may include customization options.
